name: hmi_set_start_screen
description: Set the WinCC Unified Runtime start screen in place to an existing screen (exact, case-sensitive name; screens in screen groups are found too). No screens or screen items are changed. The value is read back and the Runtime settings are validated; if validation reports a start-screen error the previous start screen is restored and the call fails. For a frame screen with a screen window, set the frame screen as the start screen.

screen_name.description: Exact name of the existing screen to start Runtime with.

target_name.description: Exact HMI device, device-item, or software name; required when multiple targets exist.

expected_current_start_screen.description: Optional guard: the start screen you expect is set now (exact name, '' for none). If it differs, the call fails and nothing changes.

on_conflict.description: Required conflict behavior; only 'fail' is supported.
